name: Logitech Panel
author: Aeon Arc
description: Logitech keyboards and mice in the Omarchy bar: battery, backlight, Fn lock and Easy-Switch channels, through OpenLogi. Not affiliated with OpenLogi or Logitech.

barWidget.description: Battery of your Logitech keyboards and mice; click for backlight, Fn lock and Easy-Switch channels. Needs OpenLogi (openlogi-bin from the AUR).

schema.label: Show percentage
schema.description: Show the battery percentage next to the device icon. Off leaves only the icon; the tooltip still has every level.

schema.label: Low battery warnings
schema.description: Send a notification when a device falls to 15%, and again at 5%, once per discharge.
